text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’d be glad to support your lead generation project for edible oil products in the US by building a focused, qualified prospect list that matches your targeting requirements.

I understand you need wholesale buyers, bulk buyers, distributors, and food market chains, with contact details such as name, email, and phone, and preferably procurement managers. I also understand the importance of following guidance carefully so the final leads list includes only qualified prospects. That kind of accuracy and discipline is a strong fit for how I work.

My background includes building clean, structured reporting solutions and working with business data in a way that improves usability and decision-making. For example, in a Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. That consolidated reporting from 14 reports into 1 and reduced monthly close reporting time from 3 days to 4 hours.

For your project, I would apply the same organized approach to lead generation and list building: gathering the right prospects, verifying contact information, cleaning the data, and making sure the list is well structured and easy to use. I’m comfortable working with spreadsheets and databases, and I can help ensure the final list is clear, consistent, and tailored to your selection criteria.

I’m also careful with terminology and can follow instructions closely, which is important for working in a food industry context and identifying the right types of buyers. If needed, I can help format the leads list so it is ready for outreach and simple to review.

I’d welcome the opportunity to support your team and help you build a high-quality list of qualified prospects.
